neutral_facts.value: The prosecution case is that on 27th June 1997 at 10:00 p.m., the victim was sitting and conversing with P.W.3 and another individual at a location near a hotel. The accused arrived at the scene, among whom one held a sword, another a Farsa, another an axe, and others had lathis. The accused attacked the victim with the weapons, causing him to fall down. The victim's injuries were noted by medical examination and post-mortem reports. The accused were arrested and charged with murder and other offenses. The trial court convicted the accused of murder and sentenced them to life imprisonment. The High Court upheld the conviction. The Supreme Court confirmed the conviction and sentence, finding the prosecution's case supported by eyewitness accounts, medical evidence, and other material evidence.

prosecution_argument.value: The prosecution argued that the FIR was registered at 10:45 p.m. on 27th June, 1997, and that the evidence of the eye-witnesses was fully corroborated by other witnesses, establishing the occurrence as deposed by the eye-witnesses and the involvement of the appellants.

quotes.text: Prosecution case is supported by the evidence of the two eye-witness which was fully corroborated by other witnesses.
Involvement of the appellants-accused was fully established.

defence_argument.value: The defence argued that the FIR was ante-dated, the injuries sustained by P.W. 3 were fake, and the non-mentioning of P.W. 3 in the Crime Details Form vitiated the prosecution's case, as well as that the delay in forwarding the Express Report caused prejudice to the appellants.

quotes.text: The FIR was ante-dated, the injuries sustained by P.W. 3 were fake, and the non-mentioning of P.W. 3 in the Crime Details Form vitiated the prosecution's case.
Delay in forwarding the Express Report caused prejudice to the appellants.

legal_principle_applied.value: The court applied the principle that the delay in forwarding the Express Report does not necessarily vitiate the case unless prejudice to the accused is shown, and that the testimony of an injured witness is accorded a special status in law.

quotes.text: Every such delay is not fatal unless prejudice to the accused is shown.
Testimony of an injured witness is accorded a special status in law.
